purpose: Recalibrate the AI-smell discriminator to the actual target reader using the frozen Phase378 A/B pair, the exact human-located A dialogue cadence, prior positive/negative generated prose, and real-source contrasts. Do not generate new fiction in this phase.

authoritative_human_evidence.first_A_ai_smell_locator: 你要那个？ / 他说过给我。 / 什么时候？

required_diagnosis: Explain why the Phase377 evaluator predicted R1 lower AI smell while the target reader judged R1 much worse.
Separate short-sentence length from repeated functional adjacency-pair cadence.
Compare the human-located A dialogue with the analogous B passage and at least one real-source dialogue passage.
Identify which Phase377 weights or omissions caused the false positive.
Define a revised discriminator that can preserve coherent scene flow while detecting synthetic micro-cadence.
State what remains unproven and what may not be used as a generation checklist.

candidate_failure_family_to_test.name: FUNCTIONALLY_EXACT_DIALOGUE_ADJACENCY_LADDER
candidate_failure_family_to_test.description: Repeated question -> exactly sufficient answer -> exactly useful follow-up, where each turn cleanly advances authorial information extraction and the exchange lacks relationship-specific interference, action competition, misunderstanding, overlap or speaker-private agenda.
candidate_failure_family_to_test.important_boundary: Short dialogue is not itself a failure. A short Q/A sequence is only high-risk when it forms a repeated functional information-acquisition ladder and contributes to target-reader AI smell.
